name: Sophos Service Disablement or Print Spooler Re-enablement
description: Detects independent command-line tampering with assessed Sophos services or re-enablement of the Print Spooler. The compliance validator performs only read-only service queries and does not execute these commands.
query: process where (((process.args : "*Sophos Endpoint Defense Service*" or process.args : "*Sophos MCS Agent*") and (process.args : "* stop *" or process.args : "*Stop-Service*" or process.args : "*Set-Service*" or process.args : "*Remove-Service*" or process.args : "*Disable-Service*" or process.args : "* config *" or process.args : "* delete *")) or (process.args : "*Spooler*" and (process.args : "*Start-Service*" or process.args : "* start *" or process.args : "*start=auto*" or process.args : "*start= auto*" or process.args : "*start=demand*" or process.args : "*start= demand*")))

technique.name: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools

author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator
false_positives: Authorized Sophos administration or approved Print Spooler configuration changes

name: LSASS and Virtualization-Based Credential Protection Disabled
description: Detects deletion or zeroing of RunAsPPL, LsaCfgFlags, or EnableVirtualizationBasedSecurity registry values associated with the assessed credential protections.
query: registry where (registry.path : "*RunAsPPL" or registry.path : "*LsaCfgFlags" or registry.path : "*EnableVirtualizationBasedSecurity") and (registry.data.strings : "*0x00000000*" or event.action : "*delete*")

technique.name: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools

author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator
false_positives: Approved credential-protection rollback or baseline deployment

name: PowerShell Logging or Constrained-Language Policy Disabled
description: Detects deletion or zeroing of PowerShell logging, transcription, or lockdown policy values. Other nonzero __PSLockdownPolicy changes require supplemental policy-diff monitoring.
query: registry where (registry.path : "*EnableScriptBlockLogging" or registry.path : "*EnableModuleLogging" or registry.path : "*EnableTranscripting" or registry.path : "*__PSLockdownPolicy") and (registry.data.strings : "*0x00000000*" or event.action : "*delete*")
author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator
false_positives: Authorized PowerShell policy troubleshooting or Group Policy changes

name: Audit Disablement or Account and Lockout Policy Manipulation
description: Detects audit policy disablement, assessed lockout/password policy changes, local account creation, or local Administrators group additions. Read-only auditpol /get and net accounts queries do not match.
query: process where ((process.name : "auditpol.exe" and (process.args : "*/clear*" or process.args : "*/remove*" or process.args : "*/success:disable*" or process.args : "*/failure:disable*")) or (process.args : "* accounts*" and (process.args : "*/lockoutthreshold:0*" or process.args : "*/lockoutduration:*" or process.args : "*/lockoutwindow:*" or process.args : "*/minpwlen:*")) or (process.args : "* user *" and process.args : "*/add*") or process.args : "*New-LocalUser*" or ((process.args : "*localgroup*" or process.args : "*Add-LocalGroupMember*") and process.args : "*Administrators*" and (process.args : "*/add*" or process.args : "*Add-LocalGroupMember*")))

technique.name: Impair Defenses: Disable Windows Event Logging

author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator
false_positives: Approved audit/account policy changes or help-desk provisioning

name: Endpoint Network LAPS and Print Protections Weakened
description: Detects common registry changes weakening assessed SMB, LLMNR, WPAD, IPv6 tunnel, LAPS, or Point and Print controls. IPv6 coverage is limited to zero/delete; other bitmask changes require policy-diff evaluation.
query: registry where (((registry.path : "*RequireSecuritySignature" or registry.path : "*EncryptData" or registry.path : "*RestrictNullSessAccess" or registry.path : "*WpadOverride" or registry.path : "*DisabledComponents" or registry.path : "*BackupDirectory" or registry.path : "*AdmPwdEnabled" or registry.path : "*RestrictDriverInstallationToAdministrators") and (registry.data.strings : "*0x00000000*" or event.action : "*delete*")) or ((registry.path : "*EnableMulticast" or registry.path : "*NoWarningNoElevationOnInstall" or registry.path : "*UpdatePromptSettings") and (registry.data.strings : "*0x00000001*" or registry.data.strings : "*0x00000002*" or event.action : "*delete*")) or (registry.path : "*mrxsmb10*Start" and (registry.data.strings : "*0x00000000*" or registry.data.strings : "*0x00000001*" or registry.data.strings : "*0x00000002*" or registry.data.strings : "*0x00000003*")))
